defects.title: The `symbol` filter cannot find a note written under a symbol's qualified name, and the answer includes only the simple-name note — while the hover twin finds both. The descriptor, curation and page claim the opposite.
defects.fix: resolve the requested name to the set {name, qualified_name} of every symbol it names (the set the handler comment and the hover already use)

defects.title: The read path opens the store read-write: a read on a never-indexed project CREATES projects/<pid>/brain.db and answers declaredAbsent; a read on a legacy store recreates a dropped brain_annotation table (DDL, db hash changes); a read removes/creates -wal/-shm.
defects.fix: open byte-read-only (getRawInstance(projectId,{readonly:true})); a missing store is a declared absence with no file created, not a fabricated one

defects.title: First default call on the 3.6 GB reference index took 17.6 s (warm calls 2.8 ms) because the read-write open runs migrations/healers; over the §6 5 s read budget.
defects.fix: read-only open (same fix as D2); re-measure cold call

defects.title: The `path` property description says a path read returns name-level notes too; the default excludes them and the includeNameLevel field says so. Two schema fields contradict each other and the generated page repeats both.
defects.fix: state the default precisely in `path` and cross-reference the flag

defects.title: Documented 'Safety: Read-only. It does not modify source files, index data, or annotations.' is false (see D2).
defects.fix: state the measured boundary: reads only; the store is opened without writing

defects.title: Charter §9 process narration in the tool's own files: milestone ids (M28/M48/M55/M63), issue numbers, 'the agent door', 'round-1 suite', 'the M28 workstream'.
At the declared cap the truncationReason advises 'Raise limit (max 200)' — an impossible action when limit is already 200.
defects.fix: make the reason adaptive: at the cap name only narrowing the filter

defects.title: The curated performance claim covers only the symbol shape: path reads and the project-wide ORDER BY have no supporting index (path scans every annotation row; every shape sorts in a temp B-tree).
defects.fix: state the measured plan per shape; no schema change is requested (store is shared code)

defects.title: Response field `includeNameLevel` reports effective inclusion, not the accepted flag: with symbol+path and includeNameLevel=false it answers true.
defects.fix: echo the accepted flag and report the effective scope in its own field

defects.title: declared mode 'annotate' names an action the schema does not expose (no mode option, no mode branch).
defects.fix: declare no mode, or document the truly mode-free schema

defects.title: The limit schema publishes no numeric bounds/default in the schema (prose only), unlike the tools that carry minimum/maximum.
defects.fix: publish minimum 1, maximum 200 and default 50 (documentation-only fields, as the Lead added for other tools)

defects.title: The generated Staleness section tells the caller to refresh the index to fix this tool's output; annotations are stored rows, and only the symbol-name resolution half can change on reindex.
defects.fix: shared generator text — request routed to the Lead (generator is Lead-owned)
